table.name: AREA_CODE_STATE
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping North American telephone area codes to the U.S. state (or territory) they serve. Likely used to derive a contestant's or voter's state from their phone number in the CONTESTANTS/VOTES context.

area_code.name: area_code
area_code.description: North American telephone area code (NANP), e.g. 201 = New Jersey, 606 = Kentucky, 845 = New York. Primary key of the table.

state.name: state
state.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory code (e.g. CA, TX, KY, NY) that the area code belongs to. 51 distinct values suggests the 50 states plus one territory (likely DC or PR).

table.name: CONTESTANTS
table.purpose: Roster of contestants, each with a unique contestant number that votes in the VOTES table refer to. Likely from a phone-in voting contest (given the AREA_CODE_STATE table).

contestant_name.name: contestant_name
contestant_name.description: Full name of the contestant; unique per row.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Primary key; unique contestant identifier (1-11), referenced by VOTES.contestant_number.

table.name: VOTES
table.purpose: Records individual votes cast for contestants, each row being one vote with the voter's phone number, state, and timestamp. Likely from a phone-in/SMS voting contest (e.g., American Idol style).

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Identifier of the contestant being voted for; references CONTESTANTS.contestant_number (many votes to one contestant).

created.name: created
created.description: Timestamp when the vote was recorded (stored as string, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS). All sample votes fall within a ~20-second window on 2018-03-09.

phone_number.name: phone_number
phone_number.description: Phone number of the voter (10-digit US number stored as integer, so leading zeros would be lost). Uniqueness 1.0 in this sample suggests one vote per phone number.

state.name: state
state.description: US state code of the voter (NY, CA, NJ; one value has a trailing newline, indicating dirty data). Presumably derived from the phone number's area code via AREA_CODE_STATE, though no join was detected.

vote_id.name: vote_id
vote_id.description: Primary key of the vote record; unique identifier for each vote.
